value.rationale: A directly defined time-ordered fourth moment resolves a time-arrow invisible to conventional stationary autocovariances. Its dimension-seven to dimension-eight exact transition, a unique positive-lag reversal at gamma=2a, and exact robustness under independent thermal diffusion provide a structural classification rather than a routine isolated calculation. The resonance is physically motivated by equality of the orientation refresh rate and the trap quadratic relaxation rate. The result does not claim universal behavior for other rates, nor experimental applicability in literal high spatial dimension.
